title: CHADI Reaches Hundreds Through MIYCN Community Outreach
author: CHADI Communications
excerpt: Our MIYCN outreach empowered mothers and caregivers with practical nutrition knowledge.
content:
Caleb Hope Alive Development Initiative (CHADI) successfully concluded a Maternal, Infant and Young Child Nutrition (MIYCN) outreach in Gombe State.

The outreach provided nutrition education, health screening, and counselling sessions for mothers and caregivers.

Over 500 beneficiaries participated in the program.

title: Youth Complete Digital Skills Training
author: CHADI Communications
excerpt: Young people graduated after completing CHADI's digital literacy programme.
content:
Participants completed intensive training in digital literacy, graphic design, entrepreneurship, and productivity tools.

The programme prepares young people for employment and self-employment opportunities.
